title: The Mother-infant Touch Study
summary: The purpose of this research study is to learn more about mother-infant interactions, including how infants experience different types of touch.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Mothers aged 21-45 years of infants aged 4-6 months
* English-speaking
* Able to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mothers of infants who have severe health or developmental disorders;
* Mothers evidencing the presence of severe psychiatric symptoms (e.g., disorganized speech, reporting delusions)
* Persons incapable of giving informed consent
* Mothers reporting recent substance use as determined by the ASI Lite
* Mothers of infants who present with neurological impairments (e.g., epilepsy/seizures)
